name: prepared-long-weapon-zero-g-wall
description: Load an ordinary zero-g save with a supported long weapon and the free left hand near a fixed wall. Coordinates are a starting template, not a verified save fixture.

zeroG.note: Set leftAtWall within 10 cm of known fixed geometry. Stroke must point into that wall in raw XR coordinates; the expected body motion is opposite it. Actual capture and native submission are required.
